resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent plane-wave DFT code)

access.notes: Any reliable plane-wave DFT code supporting N 1s core-level calculations can be used.

resources.name: PBE pseudopotentials (e.g., SSSP or GBRV library)

access.notes: Standard scalar-relativistic or fully-relativistic PBE pseudopotentials for C, N, O, H.

resources.name: Continuum solvation model (e.g., Environ for Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Required to model the aqueous electrochemical interface; equivalent solvation models (e.g., VASPsol for VASP) are acceptable.
